title: Ruleset: discard_menu
description: rules/<id>/discard_menu.yaml: the menu the story opens to pick an item from the bag (apps/session: DiscardMenu; script_common.c: openDiscardItem).

confirm_section.description: The MAPHEAD section of the confirm box's line.

confirm_line.description: The confirm box's line in that section.

cancel_trigger.description: While set, the menu closes without an item; set when the bag has nothing to pick.

chosen_variable.description: The story variable the picked item's number goes to.

no_item.description: The number that says no item was picked.
